changes: Volume, pyramid, ladder and gradeFocus blocks accept optional advanceOn: tick advances after any logged climb, including a fall; send advances only after a flash or send. Omission keeps tick behavior. The climber can change the choice before starting or adding the workout.

The advance rule applies when restSeconds is supplied, including zero for immediate advancement. Omitted restSeconds keeps the climber's own timer settings. Started runs retain their saved rule; older apps ignore advanceOn and keep advancing after any logged climb.
Add optional block externalRef values, unique within a workout, echoed in create/read block lists and results so apps can update the correct planned exercise.

Partner fourByFour blocks run natively as repeated rounds. Workout results add exact tick positions and per-block round progress, sends and falls; unknown historical attribution remains unknown. Session-ended status does not imply a completed exercise.
Session workout exports retain round pacing metadata and original visit ordinals. Workout rests honor requested zero and short durations without a mandatory ten-second changeover.

Add sessions:read for completed session entities, including private recaps, recorded duration and the connected climber's full workouts from Boardsesh or other apps. Existing logbook-only tokens keep tick-only access.

Add session and session.deleted changes, opaque tick.sessionId references, GET /v1/logbook/sessions/{id}, and authenticated read-only history links. Adding session access requires a complete replacement sync, including sessions predating the integration.

Workout results hold only that workout's ticks: ticks logged after it started, or that the climber's session recorded against one of its blocks. When a climber adds a workout to a session already running, the climbs from before it are left out, even on a climb a block queued later, and session.startedAt and durationSeconds start at the workout.

blockIndex now follows the block the climber's session recorded each tick on, so a climb queued in two blocks, or also in the climber's own block, lands on the right one instead of null or a guess. The results shape is unchanged.
Add scoped workout creation, listing, retrieval and cancellation with idempotency, lifecycle states and climber-owned results.
Publish workouts:read and workouts:write; existing tokens keep their original scopes.
Grade examples show the board's own label as its grade table spells it (6b+/V4).
climb.boardseshGrade is documented as always null for now: its V-scale form is not published yet.
First draft of v1: GET /v1/me, DELETE /v1/connection, GET /v1/logbook/changes and GET /v1/logbook/ticks/{id}, with the logbook:read, profile:read and offline_access scopes.
